limitations_and_boundaries: Nuclear hashing was validated only in cell lines, not primary cells or tissues.
The chemical screen was limited to three cancer cell lines and 188 compounds.
HDAC inhibitor analysis focused on acetyl-CoA metabolism; alternative mechanisms are not excluded.
The pilot screen used only 24-hour treatment; longer time points may reveal additional dynamics.
